summary: Iteration-5 E2E verification of ClientVerse.io after the backend IndentationError recovery. All 3 new features validated backend + frontend, plus regression breadth across 13 endpoints and full-app UI navigation. Backend: 21 passed / 1 skipped (window-expired requires DB backdating, covered by code review) in test_iteration5.py; iteration_4 + regression suites also fully pass (43 passed / 1 skipped overall). Frontend Playwright confirmed: (1) Dashboard shows goal-rollup-card with avg 46%, 10 on-track / 1 at-risk, 3 workspace groups and 11 rollup-goal-* progress bars. (2) MCP Undo prompts for a reason: cancel does nothing, empty reason triggers 'A reason is required' toast (no undo), and a real reason removes the mcp-undo-* row (status flipped to undone). (3) Registries → Webhooks new endpoint dialog exposes chips for 'commitment.*', 'mcp.*', '*' (plus approval.*, task.*, deliverable.*, and specific event names). Backend dispatcher verified: a 'commitment.*' subscription and '*' subscription both received commitment.created, while 'approval.*' did not. All previously working pages (Pipeline, Directory, Audit, MCP) load without error boundaries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1279 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split into modules (auth, mcp, webhooks, outcomes, approvals, dashboard) is overdue but not blocking.

mcp_undo() window check swallows generic exceptions on datetime parsing (except Exception: pass) — if executed_at is stored in an unexpected format the window guard is silently bypassed. Consider logging + falling back to timestamp explicitly.
event_matches() only supports trailing '.*' wildcards. Users may reasonably expect 'commitment.at_*' or leading wildcards — either document the pattern grammar in the UI or extend to fnmatch.

Non-admin users receive 403 from mcp_undo only when the invocation is in their own tenant; cross-tenant returns 404 first, which is fine but the error semantics differ. Documenting expected 403 vs 404 would help API consumers.

iteration4 test file needed reason field update to reflect new 422 contract — this is expected due to the API change but confirms the reason contract is a breaking change for any external callers of POST /mcp/invocations/{id}/undo.

/app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py (NEW — 22 tests covering goal_rollup, undo reason/window/admin-only, webhook pattern dispatch, regression breadth)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully recovered from IndentationError — no duplicate route definitions detected. Key endpoint contracts: GET /api/dashboard returns goal_rollup{total_goals,on_track,at_risk,avg_progress,workspaces[]}; POST /api/mcp/invocations/{id}/undo requires {reason:non-empty} → 422 otherwise, 60-min window enforced via executed_at, admin-only, emits mcp.tool_undone event carrying reason. Webhooks live under /api/webhooks (not /api/registry/webhooks — the latter is read-only via generic registry). event_matches() supports exact match, trailing '.*' prefix wildcards, and '*'. Regression tests confirm all core endpoints healthy.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Prior IndentationError fix verified: backend loads cleanly, no duplicate dashboard/mcp_undo/dispatch_webhooks/on_startup/root/include_router definitions in /app/backend/server.py; all 43 backend tests pass across three test files.
